summary: Retest of the 5 fixes from iteration 260 plus a regression check. All pass. Backend: 18 of 18 pytest cases pass (6 new). The wallet history shows 'Fax number · +1…' (type fax-number, -$15). A renewal transaction I inserted and then deleted showed as 'Fax number monthly · <phone>'. GET /fax returns price, autoRenew and expiresAt, and lists only fax-only numbers: Business +13341112222 is not listed, and PATCH /fax/line on it returns 404. Search results carry a nearby flag: 415 and 305 give nearbyOnly:true, 907 gives false, and a search with no area code gives false. Frontend: the Fax empty state shows 'Get a fax number', which links to /cloudivr/app/buy?purpose=fax with only Fax selected. With Voice and SIP unselected, the subtitle reads 'Pick what you need below: …'. Area code 305 shows fax-buy-nearby-note; 907 does not. A dry-run buy of +19075602331 went to /fax. That row shows fax-only-renewal '$15.00/month · renews 2026-12-13', the fax-only-autorenew toggle, '50 of 50 free pages left this month', and the card intro 'Your fax numbers always receive faxes.' Turning the toggle off showed the toast 'Auto-renew off — +19075602331 is released on 2026-12-13'; the text changed to 'released' and stayed after a reload. Regression: the Voice default, multi-select, the SMS card (links to /texting-number, hides the texting CTA), the empty state and the subtitle with SIP selected all work.

minor.issue: Found while testing, not from iteration 260: phoneTransactions action 'purchase_sub' is missing from LABEL in wallet.js, so the history shows the raw 'purchase_sub · +1785…'. Suggest a label such as 'Extra number purchase'.

issues: Minor: the sidebar item still says 'Get a Business Line' while the page title changes to 'Get a number' for Fax/SMS-only picks.

action_items: Optional: add 'purchase_sub' to LABEL in js/cloudivr-web/wallet.js.
Optional: rename the sidebar 'Get a Business Line' item, or keep it in step with the purpose picker.
critical_code_review_comments: telnyx-fax-account nearby uses phone_number.slice(2,5) !== areaCode. This is correct for +1 NANP (US/CA only), but it would break if non-+1 countries were added.
The auto-renew-off toast uses the expiresAt already shown on the row (fine). The renew toggle has no confirm step: one click turns off auto-renew. It is easy to turn back on, so this is acceptable.
fax.js mine() now only finds fax-only numbers, so sending from a Business number on web returns 404. This matches the new scope.
seed_data_creation: Bought 2 dry-run fax numbers on civr.uxtest: one in pytest (released by the fixture) and +19075602331 in the UI. Both set to status 'released' by _id with the dryRun:true filter; the user has 0 active fax numbers. Wallet debited $30 (now about $925). A test renewal transaction (TEST_ phone, $0.01) was inserted and then deleted by _id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click the 'Sign in' button by role; it is not type=submit. Dismiss cookie-allow-all first. Area codes 415 and 305 return nearby-only results; 907 returns in-area results; 212 returns 0. Run pytest with -p no:xdist (tests depend on module STATE).
